children: Malaysia's oil and gas sector is expected to be supported by continued upstream investment, resilient offshore activity and recurring contract income, RHB IB analyst Lee Yun Leon says in a note. Despite renewed Middle East tensions pushing Brent crude above $100/bbl, he retains his 2026 and 2027 price assumptions at $89/bbl and $72/bbl, respectively, expecting geopolitical risks to ease over time. Higher oil prices and tanker rates should support 4Q earnings, while Petronas' upstream capital spending rose 19% on year to 8.7 billion ringgit(?) in 1H, he says. RHB maintains an overweight rating on Malaysian integrated oil and gas sector, pegging MISC and Dialog as top picks. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
